title: Critique: dreams occur with apical amplification at a minimum

statements.text: During REM sleep adrenergic activity ceases, which isolates apical input and minimizes apical amplification, yet dreaming goes on with semantic content. Whatever phenomenal consciousness dreams have does not need the levels of apical amplification found in waking.

sources.locator: section Implications for Theories Relating Apical Amplification to States of Consciousness
sources.quote: This minimizes AA but does not prevent dreaming.

sources.locator: section Implications for Theories Relating Apical Amplification to States of Consciousness
